tool_rules.allow_if: res is not None and res.get('status') != 'cancelled'
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent must first obtain the user id and reservation id.
tool_rules.note: M0: reservation exists and is active.

tool_rules.allow_if: args.get('reason') is not None
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)
tool_rules.note: The reason is a conversation fact passed as args['reason'] (C2 v1.1).

tool_rules.allow_if: not any(db['flights'].get(f['flight_number'], {}).get('dates', {}).get(f['date'], {}).get('status') in ['flying', 'landed'] for f in res['flights'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.

tool_rules.allow_if: hours_between(res['created_at'], now) <= 24 or (args.get('reason') == 'airline cancelled flight' and 'cancelled' in [db['flights'].get(f['flight_number'], {}).get('dates', {}).get(f['date'], {}).get('status') for f in res['flights']]) or res['cabin'] == 'business' or (res['insurance'] == 'yes' and args.get('reason') in ['health', 'weather'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: Otherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true: - The booking was made within the last 24 hrs - The flight is cancelled by airline - It is a business flight - The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.
tool_rules.note: Insurance covers 'health or weather reasons' (Book flight > Travel insurance).

tool_rules.allow_if: res is not None and res.get('status') != 'cancelled'
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent must first obtain the user id and reservation id.

tool_rules.allow_if: not args['cabin'] != res['cabin'] or not any(db['flights'].get(f['flight_number'], {}).get('dates', {}).get(f['date'], {}).get('status') in ['flying', 'landed'] for f in res['flights'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.

tool_rules.allow_if: not ({(f['flight_number'], f['date']) for f in args['flights']} != {(f['flight_number'], f['date']) for f in res['flights']}) or res['cabin'] != 'basic_economy'
tool_rules.policy_ref: Basic economy flights cannot be modified. ... In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.
tool_rules.note: Reads the booked cabin, so a basic economy reservation cannot change flights even in the call that changes its cabin. Other cabins may change cabin and flights in one call (contracts 01 v1.4, gold tasks 15 and 16).

tool_rules.allow_if: not ({(f['flight_number'], f['date']) for f in args['flights']} != {(f['flight_number'], f['date']) for f in res['flights']}) or all(len(legs) > 0 and None not in legs and all(a['destination'] == b['origin'] for a, b in zip(legs, legs[1:])) and legs[0]['origin'] == res['origin'] and (legs[-1]['destination'] == res['destination'] if res['flight_type'] == 'one_way' else legs[-1]['destination'] == res['origin'] and any(l['destination'] == res['destination'] for l in legs[:-1])) for legs in [[db['flights'].get(f['flight_number']) for f in args['flights']]])
tool_rules.policy_ref: Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.

tool_rules.allow_if: user['payment_methods'].get(args['payment_id'], {}).get('source') in ['credit_card', 'gift_card']
tool_rules.policy_ref: If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
tool_rules.note: M0 applies this to every call of the tool, cabin-only changes included.

tool_rules.allow_if: res is not None and res.get('status') != 'cancelled'
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent must first obtain the user id and reservation id.

tool_rules.allow_if: args['total_baggages'] >= res['total_baggages']
tool_rules.policy_ref: The user can add but not remove checked bags.

tool_rules.allow_if: args['nonfree_baggages'] >= res['nonfree_baggages']
tool_rules.policy_ref: The user can add but not remove checked bags.
tool_rules.note: M0: paid bags are not turned into free ones.

tool_rules.allow_if: args['total_baggages'] - args['nonfree_baggages'] <= {'regular': {'basic_economy': 0, 'economy': 1, 'business': 2}, 'silver': {'basic_economy': 1, 'economy': 2, 'business': 3}, 'gold': {'basic_economy': 2, 'economy': 3, 'business': 4}}[user['membership']][res['cabin']] * len(res['passengers'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: If the booking user is a regular member: - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger (silver 1/2/3, gold 2/3/4)

tool_rules.allow_if: args['payment_id'] in user['payment_methods']
tool_rules.policy_ref: All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.

tool_rules.allow_if: res is not None and res.get('status') != 'cancelled'
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent must first obtain the user id and reservation id.

tool_rules.allow_if: len(args['passengers']) == len(res['passengers'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.

tool_rules.allow_if: user is not None
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent must first obtain the user id from the user.

tool_rules.allow_if: 1 <= len(args['passengers']) <= 5
tool_rules.policy_ref: Each reservation can have at most five passengers.

tool_rules.allow_if: all(len(legs) > 0 and None not in legs and all(a['destination'] == b['origin'] for a, b in zip(legs, legs[1:])) and legs[0]['origin'] == args['origin'] and (legs[-1]['destination'] == args['destination'] if args['flight_type'] == 'one_way' else legs[-1]['destination'] == args['origin'] and any(l['destination'] == args['destination'] for l in legs[:-1])) for legs in [[db['flights'].get(f['flight_number']) for f in args['flights']]])
tool_rules.policy_ref: The agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.
tool_rules.note: M0: flights match origin, destination and trip type.

tool_rules.allow_if: all(p['payment_id'] in user['payment_methods'] for p in args['payment_methods'])
tool_rules.policy_ref: All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.

tool_rules.allow_if: len([p for p in args['payment_methods'] if user['payment_methods'].get(p['payment_id'], {}).get('source') == 'certificate']) <= 1 and len([p for p in args['payment_methods'] if user['payment_methods'].get(p['payment_id'], {}).get('source') == 'credit_card']) <= 1 and len([p for p in args['payment_methods'] if user['payment_methods'].get(p['payment_id'], {}).get('source') == 'gift_card']) <= 3
tool_rules.policy_ref: Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards.

tool_rules.allow_if: args['nonfree_baggages'] == max(0, args['total_baggages'] - {'regular': {'basic_economy': 0, 'economy': 1, 'business': 2}, 'silver': {'basic_economy': 1, 'economy': 2, 'business': 3}, 'gold': {'basic_economy': 2, 'economy': 3, 'business': 4}}[user['membership']][args['cabin']] * len(args['passengers']))
tool_rules.policy_ref: If the booking user is a regular member: - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger (silver 1/2/3, gold 2/3/4)
tool_rules.note: M0: the free allowance is applied in full.

tool_rules.allow_if: user is not None and res is not None and res['user_id'] == args['user_id']
tool_rules.policy_ref: Always confirms the facts before offering compensation.
tool_rules.note: args['reservation_id'] and args['complaint'] are conversation facts (C2 v1.1).

tool_rules.allow_if: user['membership'] in ['silver', 'gold'] or res['insurance'] == 'yes' or res['cabin'] == 'business'
tool_rules.policy_ref: Only compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.

tool_rules.allow_if: args.get('complaint') in ['cancelled', 'delayed']
tool_rules.policy_ref: Do not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above.

tool_rules.allow_if: args.get('complaint') != 'cancelled' or ('cancelled' in [db['flights'].get(f['flight_number'], {}).get('dates', {}).get(f['date'], {}).get('status') for f in res['flights']] and args['amount'] == 100 * len(res['passengers']))
tool_rules.policy_ref: If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.

tool_rules.allow_if: args.get('complaint') != 'delayed' or ('delayed' in [db['flights'].get(f['flight_number'], {}).get('dates', {}).get(f['date'], {}).get('status') for f in res['flights']] and args.get('changed_or_cancelled', res.get('status') == 'cancelled') and args['amount'] == 50 * len(res['passengers']))
tool_rules.policy_ref: If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.

forbidden_goals.policy_ref: Basic economy flights cannot be modified.

forbidden_goals.name: insurance_added_after_booking
forbidden_goals.policy_ref: The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.

forbidden_goals.name: passenger_count_changed
forbidden_goals.policy_ref: The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.

forbidden_goals.name: free_bags_over_allowance
forbidden_goals.policy_ref: If the booking user is a regular member: - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger (silver 1/2/3, gold 2/3/4)

forbidden_goals.name: compensation_ineligible
forbidden_goals.policy_ref: Do not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.

forbidden_goals.name: compensation_duplicated
forbidden_goals.policy_ref: Do not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above.
